meta.title: Yanyan toolkit
meta.description: Adds a context-occupancy reading to the model at the first step of every turn, plus one reminder each time a session crosses 50% or 70%. Each threshold reminds once per session. A periodic clock line (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm, with the current occupancy when it is readable) is appended to a file every 6 hours by default and once when the process starts. Nothing is injected while occupancy is unavailable.
